description: Final result a dispatched builder returns. Checked afterwards by scripts/check-result.sh against the branch.

summary.description: What was done, in a few sentences.

commits.description: SHAs of commits made on the branch.

tests.description: null if no tests were run.

log_path.description: Repo-relative path of the saved raw test output, or an empty string.

denied.description: Every command or tool call that was denied.

done_when.description: One entry per item of the task's done-when (its ## Done when section, or the done-when the task states), in order. Empty only when the task states none.

item.description: The done-when item, quoted or closely paraphrased.

basis.description: observed: you ran something that shows it (a test, a command, a render) and cite it in evidence. inferred: reasoned from the code without running anything.

evidence.description: For observed: the log or file path under .ws-evidence/, the test file, or the commit that shows it. For inferred: the reasoning in one sentence.

unknowns.description: What you could not establish and what it would take (an environment, a device, a person's look). Not questions for the operator: those go in open_questions.
